item.title: Greetings from Edinburgh, where a cheeky tour guide makes art history hilarious
item.description: For anyone who grew up staring blankly at museum artwork, this is the fun that was missing: Coco leads interactive and (mostly) factual art history comedy tours.

item.title: Girl accuses Braden Peters, social media influencer known as 'Clavicular,' of rape
item.description: The allegations claim Braden Peters, also known as Clavicular, had non-consensual sex with the 17-year-old female victim after plying her with alcohol. Peters' representative denies the charges.

item.title: A 16-year-old thought he was going to die in a burning a car. Then a trucker appeared
